question: How is the foot length related to a veda-part and to a half part of the middle of the mañca?
premises: This is measured by a half part of the middle of the mañca.
inference: The foot length is taken as a veda-part measured by a half part of the middle of the mañca.
uncertainties: The technical sense of maṃcamadhyardhabhāga is not fully clear.
plain_english: A veda-part gives the foot length, measured by a half part of the middle of the mañca.
